order: Approved original pixels first; all ten final PNGs individually; scores frozen before predecessor, prior reviews, author claims, or provenance inspection.

observations.hero: Recognizable bell-backed wreck guardian. Bell, timber arch, broad feet and orange eyes read immediately. Face is a broad armored feline/reptile mask with a short fang mouth; original has a narrower downward-projecting woody snout and more forceful ivory jaw silhouette.
observations.01-front: Broad symmetrical forehead and tiny mouth dominate the difference; original face has a more pointed, tooth-led lower contour. Bell and leg spread read well.
observations.02-left: Long projecting snout over a thick horizontal jaw; tall upright fence construction dominates the body. Original feels more densely collapsed wreckage.
observations.03-right: Same snout/jaw separation and regular fence rails on opposite side; robust three-dimensional silhouette.
observations.04-back: Tall plank cage and round rear cap are coherent but generic; no direct rear reference exists.
observations.05-top: Face is broad and tapered but substantially more regular and shield-like than original. Bell nesting is clear.
observations.06-diag-front: Large armored forehead overwhelms the small tooth ring. Bell mouth and clapper remain readable.
observations.07-diag-left: Strong bell and irregular plank tips; repetitive rail scaffold reads cleaner than the concept's tangled wreckage.
observations.08-diag-right: Consistent full-volume construction; head is a long horizontal wedge rather than the original's descending jaw mass.
observations.09-diag-back: Stable low-poly shell and supports; rear remains extrapolation, not reference-verified likeness.

limits: Static likeness only. Original contains only two similar front three-quarter depictions; unseen sides cannot independently prove matching design. No runtime, animation, performance or gameplay approval.
